title: [Master]- Changing Sales Order Line Description on a Sales Order unexpectedly changes the invoice total amounts.Changes
summary: Fixed an issue where editing a sales order line's description would unexpectedly change invoice totals by ensuring calculations only run when the item number changes.
key_points: The Description field validation was unconditionally recalculating totals on every edit
Total recalculation now only triggers when the item number actually changes
Prevention of duplicate delta updates to invoice amounts
Includes test coverage for the fix
Affects all localized versions of the sales order subform page
quote: Changing Sales Order Line Description on a Sales Order unexpectedly changes the invoice total amounts.
